title: The first install route points at a releases page with nothing on it
foundBy: session agent, following README.md and INSTALL.md as a first-time reader
details:
INSTALL.md §1 leads with "Download a release": fetch the archive and `checksums.txt`, verify the checksum, then the cosign signature. No v* tag has been pushed and `.github/workflows/release.yml` fires on a tag, so the releases page is empty.

A first-time reader takes the first route offered and finds nothing to download.

Cutting the first tag makes the whole section true. Until then the page says so.

notes.text: INSTALL.md now says plainly that no version has been tagged, which is the sentence the tracer repository already carries. This record stays open until a tag exists.
